mapper.sql: l.id AS id, l.order_no AS orderNo, l.biz_type AS bizType, l.goods_id AS goodsId, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, g.barcode AS barcode, g.name AS goodsName, c.name AS categoryName, u.name AS unitName, g.spec AS spec, g.is_weighed AS isWeighed, l.quantity AS quantity, l.cost_price AS costPrice, l.amount AS amount, l.reason AS reason, di.label AS reasonLabel, l.apply_name AS applyName, l.status AS status, l.auditor_name AS auditorName, l.audit_time AS auditTime, l.audit_remark AS auditRemark, l.remark AS remark, l.create_time AS createTime

FROM loss_order l JOIN goods g ON g.id = l.goods_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id LEFT JOIN unit u ON u.id = g.unit_id LEFT JOIN sys_dict d ON d.dict_type = 'loss_reason' LEFT JOIN sys_dict_item di ON di.dict_id = d.id AND di.value = l.reason
